Five test files call `buildAnthropicCcHeaders` directly:

- `tests/anthropicCcAuthModes.test.ts`
- `tests/anthropicCcBetaComposition.test.ts`
- `tests/anthropicCcHeaderSuppression.test.ts`
- `tests/anthropicCcInlineToolsBetaFlags.test.ts`
- `tests/anthropicCcOAuthBetaComposition.test.ts`

Three functions also call it: `buildAnthropicCcRequestFromContext` and `buildAnthropicCcRequest` in `src/anthropic-cc/request.ts`, and `streamAnthropicCc` in `src/anthropic-cc/stream.ts`. Through those, 26 more test files run it indirectly, such as `tests/anthropicCcManagedBetaRequest.test.ts`, `tests/anthropicCcInlineToolsBetaWire.test.ts` and `tests/anthropicCcTranscriptRequestOverride.test.ts`. If your change affects the request headers, rerun those as well. The simplest way is to run the whole `tests/anthropicCc*` suite.
